issues.description: Several consumed inputs have no producer in either supplied program (meetingdate_datadate_match, compustat19502010_disclosure, firmage, ipo, spinoff and ret_fiscal_date). The companion SDC program reads the raw SDC dataset_ma under [redacted-path-ad3fb8f2201f] and writes a distinct dataset_ma under [redacted-path-fec4d2209add]; MainCode then expects gvkey/fyear/dealnumber in that output, but the producer does not construct gvkey/fyear. The generated dataset_irrc handoff also needs an author-confirmed schema for MainCode’s cn6/year, gvkey/fyear and datadate joins; the director keep list omits cn6 before the later CRSP/Compustat merge, which may or may not add it.

The online appendix reports Tables A1–A9 covering robustness, tenure diversity, death-event reconciliation/returns, matched restatements, additional controls and SEM, but the package contains no executable appendix analysis entry point. MainCode_JAR.DO produces its supplied Table 3 specifications and a lowess plot only; appendix narrative and results do not establish the missing program order, inputs or output schemas.

Each of the five Table 3 model groups writes to table3.xls with replace on its first regression call and append on its second. The later groups therefore overwrite earlier groups, leaving only the last group’s two estimates.

actions.description: Obtain the author-prepared inputs or confirm a compatible local-product mapping and required input schemas for the full pipeline.
steps: Verify the RISK.GSET candidate against the legacy CN6/YEAR/CBOARD input and confirm the author-required 1990–2006 range; verify RISK.RMGOVERNANCE against the CUSIP/Year/CBOARD input and its 2007–2015 range. Convert only after those source and period mappings are confirmed.

Provide the author-prepared tenure_irrc19962010_did input with its actual fields and unique director IDs, plus meetingdate_datadate_match with gvkey, meetingdate, datadate and diff_meetdate_datadate. The local RiskMetrics director tables and the author’s separate Co-opted Boards link workbook are candidates, not confirmed substitutes for this cleaned input.
Provide or verify the Compustat segment source with gvkey, datadate, stype, snms and SICS1 for BUSSEG observations. Confirm history includes the prior available segment record used for nseg_lag.

Provide or map compustat19502012 and compustat19502010_disclosure to the code’s GVKEY/FYEAR accounting columns. Confirm lag construction retains the prior-year observations needed before the 1998–2010 estimation filter.

Provide the consumed crspcomp19502010_prc0mth author-prepared merge or a documented compatible construction mapping from local Compustat/CRSP sources; do not treat separate monthly tables as the merged author file.
Provide ret_fiscal_date with GVKEY/FYEAR/DATE/RET or its exact producer. Confirm prior fiscal observations needed for the 1998 return lags and coverage through 2010.

Provide ceo_Execucomp19922010 with the consumed GVKEY/YEAR/EXECID/CEO fields, including CEOTENURE and I_CEOFOUNDER. The linked author Compensation Data page lists a different Delta/Vega product and is not a direct replacement on current evidence.

Provide the SDC input schema or export so dataset_ma retains GVKEY, FYEAR and DealNumber/dealnumber through the companion stage; confirm the one-year predecessor required by MainCode’s acquisition lags.

Provide author-prepared firmage (GVKEY/FYEAR/LN_FIRMAGE), ipo (year/CN6/I_IPO_LAG) and spinoff (year/CN6/I_SPINOFF_LAG), or their exact producers. Preserve the documented Ritter/Capital IQ/Hoover/CRSP founding-year measure rather than replacing it with pure CRSP listing age.
Before a later authorized run, validate file readability, required keys/fields and periods, then inspect generated dataset_irrc and dataset_ma schemas against the consuming MainCode merge keys.

review_notes: Saved checkpoint after reading the datasheet, appendix, both native Stata programs, the frozen dependency list, product catalog, and bounded local/package/software probes. All new raw inputs and source paths are assessed as candidates only; one-row SAS reads do not establish population or historical coverage.
firmlist.xlsx is a one-column GVKEY identifier list and neither do-file imports it; it is not a final analysis panel.
No analysis_only scope is supported because there is no supplied complete analysis dataset or demonstrated compatible full panel bypass.

Manual IRRC/ID construction described in source comments is historical preparation. The preferred requirement is the author-prepared cleaned director input; do not add the original proxy/Capital IQ lookup as a live requirement when that compatible file is supplied.

Local SAS product probes use row_limit=1 and confirm only readability plus the listed sample columns; they do not establish full population or historical coverage. They do not create a SAS runtime requirement for this Stata-authored workflow.

The preparation code generates dataset_irrc and dataset_ma in separate, traceable locations, and MainCode generates num_acq/num_acq_lag from the produced dataset_ma. The unresolved concern is the required key/schema contract, not absence of these producer blocks.
MainCode’s `replace`→`append` proposal changes only output behavior; it leaves all five model groups and their specifications intact. No proposed edit was applied.
